scenes.title: Come on in
scenes.summary: Show a friend around your living room.

turns.message: Your place is so cozy! Where can I sit?
turns.reply: You can sit on the couch.
wrongReplies: You can seat in the sofa.
You can sit over the chair-long.
turns.note: A couch (or sofa) is a long, comfortable seat for several people.

turns.message: Where can I put my drink?
turns.hint: The low table in front of the couch.
wrongReplies: On the table for coffee only.
On the short living table.
turns.note: A coffee table is a low table in front of a sofa.

wrongReplies: Thanks! They’re pillows to throw away.
Thanks! They’re cushion throws.
turns.note: Throw pillows are small decorative cushions for a couch or bed.

turns.message: What do you call that little table next to the couch?
turns.hint: It’s beside the arm of the couch.
wrongReplies: It’s an ending table.
It’s the table at the final.
turns.note: An end table is a small table beside a sofa or chair.

turns.message: The kitchen and living room feel like one big space.
turns.hint: There are no walls between them.
turns.reply: Yeah, it has an open layout.
wrongReplies: Yeah, it has a layout opened.
Yeah, it has open plan of rooms.
turns.note: An open layout has connected rooms without many walls.

scenes.closing: I love it. You have to show me the rest! 🏡

scenes.title: Staying over
scenes.summary: Help a guest get comfortable in the bedroom.

turns.message: Thanks for letting me stay! Where can I put my clothes?
turns.reply: You can put them in the dresser.
wrongReplies: You can put them on the clothing drawer furniture.
You can leave them inside the dress.
turns.note: A dresser is a low piece of furniture with drawers for clothes.

turns.message: Is there somewhere for my phone by the bed?
turns.hint: The small table right next to the bed.
turns.reply: There’s a nightstand by the bed.
wrongReplies: There’s the night table of sleep.
A small table is near to bed.
turns.note: A nightstand is a small table beside a bed.

turns.message: I like to read before I sleep 📖
turns.hint: There’s a small light on that table.
turns.reply: There’s a lamp on the nightstand.
wrongReplies: There’s a light in the sleeping table.
A lamp is above the night stand bed.
turns.note: A lamp gives light. You can say it’s “on” the nightstand.

turns.hint: There’s another blanket in the closet.
turns.reply: There’s an extra blanket in the closet.
wrongReplies: There’s one blanket more in the cupboard.
The closet has an additionally blanket.

turns.hint: It’s big enough to step inside.
wrongReplies: Yeah, it’s a closet that you walk on.
Yeah, it’s a closet for walking.
turns.note: A walk-in closet is big enough to enter and move around in.

scenes.closing: This is better than a hotel 😄 Good night!

scenes.title: Settling in
scenes.summary: Talk about moving in and setting up your home.

turns.message: How’s the new apartment? All settled?
wrongReplies: Not yet. I still unpacking the things.
Not yet. I am opening my packages still.
turns.note: “Unpacking” is taking things out of boxes after a move or trip.

turns.reply: Yes, it was delivered this morning.
wrongReplies: Yes, it was delivery in the morning.
Yes, they bringed it this morning.
turns.note: “Delivered” means brought to your home by a delivery service.

turns.message: What did you do last night?
wrongReplies: I built the bookshelf together.
I joined all the bookshelf.
turns.note: “Put together” means to build something from separate parts.

turns.message: Where are you keeping your plants?
turns.hint: You attached boards to the wall.
wrongReplies: I put some shelves uping.
I raised some shelf boards on wall.
turns.note: “Put up” means to attach something to a wall.

turns.message: Does the living room feel cozy yet?
turns.hint: You put a big decorative rug on the floor.
turns.reply: Yeah, we got a new area rug.
wrongReplies: Yeah, we bought a carpet for one area only.
Yeah, we got a rug of the area.
turns.note: An area rug covers part of a floor, unlike wall-to-wall carpet.
